caption:
GTA 6 finally has patch notes 🛠️ Update 1.002.002 (Nov 23) fixes 7 things, after two updates with no notes at all.

Crashes, autosaves, phone calls that wouldn't trigger, a wanted level you couldn't lose, stuck weather, the gym deadlift bar and fences. Still no 60 FPS mode.

What should Rockstar fix next? 👇

Sources: Rockstar's notes as reported by VICE, Dot Esports, Comicbook, RockstarINTEL.

Fan page, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

#gta6 #gtavi #gta6update #patchnotes #gaming #ps5 #xbox
first_comment: Full patch notes (EN + ES) on vicereplay.com 🔗

tips.title: Crashes
tips.text: Several problems that made the game crash are fixed.

tips.title: Autosave
tips.text: Autosaves that didn't work correctly now save.

tips.title: Phone calls
tips.text: Calls that never came, including ones you need to move the story on, now trigger.

tips.title: Wanted level
tips.text: No more wanted level you couldn't lose.

tips.title: Weather
tips.text: Weather no longer gets stuck for hours.

tips.title: Gym + fences
tips.text: The gym deadlift bar works, and partners hand over the bags you sell to fences.

cta.title: What should they fix next?
cta.text:
Comment below. Still no 60 FPS mode on consoles.
